environment: node v24.19.0, python3, git; scratch repos from cli-runner

cases.title: Clean up section holds the branches.py command, the id filter and no glob
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: The Clean up section is read
cases.then: The section names `branches.py list --repo . --kind attempt`, `Keep the entries whose id equals this slice id, ignoring case`, no `-attempt-*`, no `sdlc/<id>`
cases.expected: The section names `branches.py list --repo . --kind attempt`, `Keep the entries whose id equals this slice id, ignoring case`, no `-attempt-*`, no `sdlc/<id>`
cases.actual: text of the Clean up section matches

cases.title: Listing S-1 attempts next to S-10, S-1a and a lowercase s-1 keeps only the S-1 ids
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: branches.py list --kind attempt runs, and the keep filter from the prompt applies
cases.then: S-1 keeps S-1-attempt-1, S-1-attempt-2 and s-1-attempt-3 (ignoring case); S-10 and S-1a keep only their own; exit 0; tree unchanged
cases.expected: S-1 keeps S-1-attempt-1, S-1-attempt-2 and s-1-attempt-3 (ignoring case); S-10 and S-1a keep only their own; exit 0; tree unchanged

evidence.title: branches.py list, 7 branches
evidence.inline:
$ python3 skills/sdlc/branches.py list --repo <scratch> --kind attempt
exit: 0
{"ok": true, "command": "list", "format": "sdlc/{name}", "kind": "attempt", "branches": [S-1 n=1, S-10 n=1, S-1a n=1, S-1 n=2, s-1 n=3]}
sdlc/S-1 and sdlc/run-3 are not listed.
tree: unchanged

evidence.title: scratch repo refs
evidence.inline: before and after list: identical (treeUnchanged true)

cases.title: A slice with no attempt branches keeps nothing; a repo with no attempts lists none
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: branches.py list --kind attempt runs, and the keep filter from the prompt applies
cases.then: Empty keep list for S-2; branches [] and exit 0 with no attempts
cases.expected: Empty keep list for S-2; branches [] and exit 0 with no attempts

cases.title: Lookalike names (suffix x, empty number, doubled suffix, slash, S-11) never match S-1
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: branches.py list --kind attempt runs, and the keep filter from the prompt applies
cases.then: Only sdlc/S-1-attempt-<n> style names are kept for S-1 and the tail lookalikes are not listed as S-1 attempts
cases.expected: Only sdlc/S-1-attempt-<n> style names are kept for S-1 and the tail lookalikes are not listed as S-1 attempts

cases.title: A custom branch format lists attempts under its own spelling and ignores other prefixes
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: branches.py list --kind attempt runs, and the keep filter from the prompt applies

cases.title: Running list twice gives the same output and changes no ref
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: branches.py list --kind attempt runs, and the keep filter from the prompt applies

cases.title: A path that is not a repository exits 2 with an error message
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: branches.py list --kind attempt runs, and the keep filter from the prompt applies
cases.then: non-zero exit and an error, no list
cases.expected: non-zero exit and an error, no list

cases.title: The scan regexes detect a glob added to the section (mutation)
cases.given: Scratch git repo made by cli-runner, or the integrator.md text
cases.when: The Clean up section is read
cases.then: Both `-attempt-*` and `sdlc/<id>` regexes match the mutated text
cases.expected: Both `-attempt-*` and `sdlc/<id>` regexes match the mutated text
